mapper.select: SELECT lc.linked_card_id, lc.user_id, lc.card_id, lc.card_company_code, cc.card_company_name, lc.card_name, lc.card_image_name, rc.card_num, lc.represent_yn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN registered_card_tbl rc ON lc.card_id = rc.card_id INNER JOIN card_company_tbl cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.card_company_code INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON lc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND rc.delete_yn = 'N' AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN lc.represent_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lc.linked_card_id DESC

SELECT lc.linked_card_id, lc.user_id, lc.card_id, lc.card_company_code, cc.card_company_name, lc.card_name, lc.card_image_name, rc.card_num, lc.represent_yn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN registered_card_tbl rc ON lc.card_id = rc.card_id INNER JOIN card_company_tbl cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.card_company_code INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON lc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.linked_card_id = #{linkedCardId} AND rc.delete_yn = 'N' AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN registered_card_tbl rc ON lc.card_id = rc.card_id WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND rc.delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT lc.linked_card_id, lc.user_id, lc.card_id, lc.card_company_code, cc.card_company_name, lc.card_name, lc.card_image_name, rc.card_num, lc.represent_yn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN registered_card_tbl rc ON lc.card_id = rc.card_id INNER JOIN card_company_tbl cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.card_company_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.linked_card_id != #{linkedCardId} AND rc.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY lc.linked_card_id LIMIT 1
